learning_objective: 遇到困难时,孩子能用语言或图片(求助卡)主动发起一次“帮我”的请求,而不是哭闹或放弃(3 次中≥2 次达成)。
intro_zh: 有时候事情有点难,东西打不开、够不到。这时候我不用着急,我可以说“帮我一下”,或者递出求助卡,大人就会来帮我。
intro_en: Sometimes things are hard. A lid will not open, or something is too high. I do not have to worry. I can say help me, or hand over my help card, and a grown-up will come to help.

steps.text_zh: 事情有点难,我先停一停。
steps.text_en: When something is hard, I stop for a moment.
steps.narration_zh: 事情有点难的时候,我先停一停,看看是哪里遇到困难。
steps.narration_en: When something is hard, I stop and notice what is difficult.

steps.text_zh: 我看着大人,说“帮我一下”。
steps.text_en: I look at a grown-up and say help me please.
steps.narration_zh: 我看着旁边的大人,用清楚的话说“帮我一下”。
steps.narration_en: I look at a grown-up nearby and clearly say help me please.

steps.text_zh: 不想说话时,我递出求助卡。
steps.text_en: If I do not want to talk, I hand over my help card.
steps.narration_zh: 如果我不想说话,我可以把求助卡递给大人,他就明白我需要帮忙。
steps.narration_en: If I do not want to talk, I can hand my help card to a grown-up, and they understand I need help.

steps.text_zh: 大人来帮我,我们一起做,就容易多了。
steps.text_en: A grown-up helps me, we do it together, and it becomes easy.
steps.narration_zh: 大人过来帮我,我们一起做,难的事情就变容易了。
steps.narration_en: A grown-up comes to help, we do it together, and the hard thing becomes easy.

practice_trials.prompt_zh: 你的水彩笔盖子拧不开,有点难。轮到你,你可以怎么做?
practice_trials.prompt_en: The cap on your marker will not open and it is hard. Your turn — what can you do?
practice_trials.reinforce_en: You reached out for help. Well done.

practice_trials.prompt_zh: 你想拿的书在高高的架子上,够不到。你可以怎么做?
practice_trials.prompt_en: The book you want is high on the shelf and you cannot reach. What can you do?
practice_trials.answer_zh: 我递出求助卡,请大人帮忙拿。
practice_trials.answer_en: I hand over my help card so a grown-up can reach it.
practice_trials.reinforce_zh: 你用求助卡请人帮忙,真聪明。
practice_trials.reinforce_en: You used your help card. So smart.

practice_trials.prompt_zh: 拼图有一块怎么都拼不上,你有点着急。你可以怎么做?
practice_trials.prompt_en: One puzzle piece will not fit and you feel a little upset. What can you do?
practice_trials.answer_zh: 我先深呼吸,再说“帮我一下”。
practice_trials.answer_en: I take a breath, then say help me please.
practice_trials.reinforce_zh: 你没有放弃,选择了求助,很棒。
practice_trials.reinforce_en: You did not give up, you reached out for help. Great.

social_choice.scenario_zh: 你在穿外套,拉链卡住了,拉不上……你可以怎么做?
social_choice.scenario_en: You are putting on your coat and the zipper is stuck... what can you do?

options.outcome_zh: 你请大人帮忙,大人几下就帮你把拉链拉好了,你继续开心地玩。
options.outcome_en: You reach out to a grown-up, they help with the zipper in a moment, and you keep playing happily.

options.outcome_zh: 你把求助卡递过去,大人明白了,过来帮你,你们一起把拉链拉好。
options.outcome_en: You hand over your help card, a grown-up understands and helps you zip it up together.

visual_cards.caption_zh: 停一停 → 看着大人 → 说“帮我一下”。
visual_cards.caption_en: Stop, look at a grown-up, say help me please.

visual_cards.caption_zh: 帮我一下,好吗? / 我需要帮忙。
visual_cards.caption_en: Can you help me please? / I need help.

visual_cards.caption_zh: 太难了不用急,求助也很棒。
visual_cards.caption_en: Hard is okay, reaching out for help is great.

visual_cards.caption_zh: 难 → 停 → 求助 → 一起完成。
visual_cards.caption_en: Hard, stop, reach out, finish together.

review_zh: 我学会了在需要的时候求助:事情太难,我先停一停,看着大人说“帮我一下”,或者递出求助卡。求助不是做错事,求助以后,难的事情就变容易了。
review_en: I learned to reach out for help when I need it: when something is hard, I stop, look at a grown-up, and say help me please, or hand over my help card. Reaching out for help is a good thing, and the hard thing becomes easy.
review_flags: 草稿:循证内容,正式使用前需专业人员按孩子的沟通方式(口语/图片/AAC)个别化调整。
方法说明:选题库原记 naturalistic_intervention(自然情境教学),但生成器暂无该方法的完整规则文件;本课改用与“请求(mand)”同为首选、且生成器已就绪的 aac_pecs(图片交换沟通),核心引用 bondy_frost_1994 即 PECS 原始文献,教学内涵一致(自然情境中主动发起请求)。
